identity.name: Kubernetes Pod Exfiltrates Data via wget to C2
identity.summary: An attacker uses a compromised Kubernetes pod to download a malicious payload from a remote C2 server and execute it. Cortex should detect unusual network communication from the pod and process behavi
identity.description: An attacker uses a compromised Kubernetes pod to download a malicious payload from a remote C2 server and execute it. Cortex should detect unusual network communication from the pod and process behavior.

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Unusual Pod Network Communication
biocs.description: A pod makes an outbound network connection to a remote IP not typically seen in normal operations
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.50'
| filter actor_process_image_name like '%pod%'

abiocs.name: Pod Executes Suspicious Script
abiocs.description: A pod executes a script downloaded from a remote C2 server
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = '/tmp/malware.sh'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name like '%pod%'

xql_queries.name: Detect Outbound C2 Connection from Pod
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.50'
| filter actor_process_image_name like '%pod%'
